messages:
mia-marketing: morning — quick daily check-in:
what I did: finalized draft for the benchmark post, uploaded Figma comps to the content-calendar, emailed legal for the quote clearance.
blockers: need final approval on the benchmark graphs from eng (cc @raj-engineer), and hero image sizes from design.
plan today: address edits from sam, schedule publish for next Tue if all green.

sam-growth: saw the draft, looks good overall. small asks: shorten the lead, add a TL;DR bullets list, and can we include one customer quote? :+1:
I can loop in outreach for permission on the quote.

zoe-content: I trimmed the intro and added TL;DR bullets in the doc. Uploaded alt headline options. left comments where I think we can tighten claims.

ana-design: sorry, I mean ana-design — hero images exported at the wrong width yesterday, re-exporting now.
should have 1200x630 and 600x315 variants by EOD. any preference for one visual concept?

raj-engineer: re: benchmark graphs — I pushed updated charts to the shared bucket (s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/1767/).
notes: we used 8k context, batch size 16, quantized runs on A100s. if you want different axes or raw data let me know.

mia-marketing: perfect, thanks raj. can you also add a tiny caption on methodology for the post (one sentence) so legal knows it's reproducible?

raj-engineer: yep — added caption in the doc: `Methodology: 8k context, dynamic batching (up to 16), quantized FP16 runs on A100, median of 3 runs.`

olivia-prod: quick FYI — Ops flagged that the benchmark IP needs a product review before publish. I'm scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow at 10:15 PT with prod + eng + marketing.

mia-marketing: added to calendar. sam, can you confirm outreach for the customer quote by EOD?

sam-growth: on it — pinging the contact now. will update thread.

ana-design: uploaded both hero concepts to the content calendar and left an internal poll. please vote so we can lock visuals. :paintbrush:

kube-bot: deploy reminder — staging preview for the blog will be available once ops approves the IP review. Use `/preview 1767` to fetch the latest build.

mia-marketing: awesome — small checklist for today: 1) legal clearance, 2) product IP review, 3) customer quote confirm, 4) design vote. if anyone's blocked ping me directly. otherwise i'll move to schedule Tuesday publish after approvals. :rocket:
